data.title: Membership
data.description: Join a club built and maintained by its members.
data.body:
How to apply

  1. Applicants must be United States citizens and at least 18 years old.
  2. Complete an application and arrange a sponsor who is a current Pine Tree Rifle Club member.
  3. Submit the application with the recovered requirements’ $10 nonrefundable application fee. Applicants who are not NRA members must also complete an NRA membership application.
  4. After acceptance, attend the new candidates meeting with your sponsor.

Mail applications to Pine Tree Rifle Club, P.O. Box 45, Johnstown, NY 12095. Please confirm current fees and requirements with the club.

data.title: History
data.body:
A club built by its members

The first meeting was held in the spring of 1937 at the home of Robert C. Kilmer.

  1. 1938: Land was leased for a 100-yard range and trap shooting.
  2. 1940: Members built the clubhouse during the fall and winter.
  3. 1942: The club purchased the thirty-acre property outright.
  4. 1947: Members added a well, improved roads, parking, bench rests and the rifle range.
